name: Availability Zones
description: What an Availability Zone is, how AZs isolate failure within a Region, why production workloads span at least two, and how per-account AZ name mapping affects cross-account coordination.

competencyLevels.descriptor: Can say an AZ is an isolated site inside a Region.
Can explain why a workload must span two AZs and check whether a given design actually does.
indicators: Checks load balancer subnets, database Multi-AZ, and instance spread.
Knows AZ names map differently per account.

competencyLevels.descriptor: Has built a multi-AZ deployment and verified it survives stopping one AZ's instances.
Has run or responded to an AZ failure or game day in production.
